evidence.source_statement: For each agreed reproducible behavior of an authorized C-to-Rust port, run the original C baseline and Rust implementation with equivalent inputs and relevant environment, compare observable outputs, exit codes and side effects, and document any intentionally accepted differences.
source_conditions: An authorized C-to-Rust port has an agreed upstream baseline and equivalent test cases are runnable or reference observations are available.
source_exceptions: Documented accepted deviations and justified nondeterministic differences; missing baseline executability must be reported as a verification gap, not silently treated as a passing test.

interpretation.situation_scope: Relationships describe relevant contexts, not exhaustive triggers or narrower rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intent relationships describe inferred underlying outcomes; normative authority remains with the original rule.
interpretation.effective_rules: No rule, rule profile, or execution instruction is altered by linking.
